bio: Housed in Das Marent hotel, this stylish fine dining restaurant with its modern Alpine-inspired decor fully lives up to the name. Brothers Alexander and Christian Marent pour their heart and soul into providing their guests with a memorable dining experience. Crafted with meticulous care and high-quality ingredients, the dishes of chef Christian Marent showcase a creative fusion of regional and international flavours. The Tyrolean salmon trout with radish and saffron vinegar, and the rack of lamb with chorizo, black-eyed beans, sweetcorn and jalapeño are fine examples of this successful blend of influences. The wine list primarily features Austrian and Spanish choices. Friendly and adept service....
